description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectDao class, a data access object responsible for managing Project-related database operations within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, project validation, and reporting, leveraging Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: ProjectDao
classes.description: Data access object for handling database operations related to projects, including CRUD, validation, and reporting functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Persists a Project entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteProjects
methods.description: Marks multiple projects as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a project by its ID, if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingProjectIds
methods.description: Returns a list of project IDs that exist and are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Fetches a list of projects based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getProjectsPaginator
methods.description: Prepares a paginated query for fetching projects based on filters.

methods.name: getProjectsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of projects matching filter criteria.

methods.name: isProjectNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a project name is already used within a specific customer, optionally excluding a given project ID.

methods.name: isProjectAdmin
methods.description: Determines if an employee is assigned as a project admin.

methods.name: getProjectIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all project IDs, optionally including deleted projects.

methods.name: getProjectIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Returns project IDs for projects where a specific employee is a project admin.

methods.name: hasTimesheetItemsForProject
methods.description: Checks if there are timesheet entries associated with a specific project.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Fetches report data criteria for projects based on search filters.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts report data criteria for projects based on search filters.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectReport
methods.description: Calculates the total duration for project reports based on filters.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDetailedReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Fetches detailed report data for project activities.

methods.name: getProjectReportActivityDetailedCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts detailed report data entries for project activities.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectActivityDetailedReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration for detailed project activity reports.

methods.name: getCommonQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Adds common filtering conditions for project and timesheet queries.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDetailedReportQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds query for detailed project activity reports including filters.

methods.name: getProjectActivityReportCriteriaPaginator
methods.description: Prepares paginated query for detailed project activity reports.

methods.name: getProjectReportQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs query with filters for project reports.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectActivityDetailedReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration for activity-specific detailed reports.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumbersForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Returns employee numbers accessible to a project admin.

methods.name: getUnselectableProjectIds
methods.description: Gets project IDs that are associated with timesheet items and thus unavailable for selection.

methods.name: getActivityIdsOfProjectInTimesheetItems
methods.description: Retrieves activity IDs linked to a given project in timesheet entries.
